{{Infobox auto|title=Prayer of Yama|type=[[Blessing]]}}
The '''Prayer of Yama''' is a [[blessing]], a crafted enchanted book that stores {{MCW|Flame}}, {{MCW|Fire Aspect}} I and {{MCW|Fire Protection}} III. It is crafted from four {{MCW|Fire Charge|fire charges}} and four gold ingots.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The book in the center must be a [[Hell-Bound Book]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/flame_fire_aspect_fire_protection.json}}</ref> The crafted item is named "Blessing", with "Prayer of Yama" as a dark gray lore line.

== Usage ==
The Prayer of Yama is applied to equipment in an [[anvil]], like an {{MCW|Enchanted Book|enchanted book}}. Flame applies to bows, Fire Aspect to swords, spears and maces, and Fire Protection to armor. Applying the book to one item gives only the enchantments that item supports.

== Trivia ==
* Yama is the god of death in Hindu and Buddhist tradition, ruler of the underworld; the pack calls its Nether "[[Hell]]".
